dataset.description: Data fields will include personal information (age, nationality), demographic data, opinions on topics such as civic activity, social engagement, state policy, language, and media use.

distribution.title: The collection of survey data is intended to enhance theoretical research by providing practical insights into the views of different demographic groups on perspectives on meaning of national identity, sense of belonging,  civic togetherness, as well as their experiences and views on social and geographical mobility and mutual trust.

dataset.title: Sociological survey

dmp.description: The aim of the SRP project is to conduct a comprehensive analysis of Latvia's cohesion policy since 1991, in an interdisciplinary way combining philosophical reflections on basic concepts, sociological analysis and data, legal, geographical, economic, social, cultural, ideological and other aspects. This DMP will be used to store survey data and bibliography used to convey the project. DMP is made within State Research Programme "Development of a cohesive and civically active society" project "Vectors of societal cohesion: from cohesion around the nation-state (2012-2018) to a cohesive civic community for the security of the state, society and individuals (2024-2025)" (VPP-KM-SPASA-2023/1-0002).
dmp.ethical_issues_description: One primary ethical concern revolves around privacy and consent. Participants must be fully informed about the data being collected, how it will be used, and any potential risks involved. Additionally, ensuring that the data collected is anonymized and securely stored is crucial to protect individuals' identities and prevent unauthorized access.
